shelves.label: LandingProduct System
shelves.description: Enterprise landing/product sections with dedicated chapter guidance, starter kits, and deeper operating-model language.

shelves.label: Landing and Marketing
shelves.description: General marketing sections, landing-page building blocks, and non-LandingProduct conversion surfaces.

shelves.label: Data and Admin
shelves.description: Dashboards, tables, charts, monitoring, timelines, and administrative information surfaces.

shelves.label: Forms and Authoring
shelves.description: Input systems, editors, uploads, search filters, and workflow authoring tools.

shelves.label: Feedback and State
shelves.description: Error states, dialogs, consent surfaces, loaders, and operational feedback layers.

shelves.label: UI Primitives
shelves.description: Small reusable surface elements used as atoms or composable presentation building blocks.

shelves.label: Navigation and Command
shelves.description: Menus, command surfaces, navigational scaffolding, and page-structure affordances.

shelves.label: Motion and Typography
shelves.description: Animated text, reveal systems, motion primitives, and presentation choreography.

shelves.label: Backgrounds and Effects
shelves.description: Ambient backgrounds, visual effects, particles, glow systems, and decorative depth layers.

shelves.label: Interactive Showcase
shelves.description: Carousels, mockups, cards, media comparison surfaces, and high-touch presentation components.

shelves.label: Misc and Uncurated
shelves.description: Components that still need sharper shelf placement or clearer naming before they feel fully curated.

starterLanes.label: Marketing Quickstart
starterLanes.useWhen: You need a standard marketing page without entering the heavier enterprise subsystem.

starterLanes.label: Dashboard Core
starterLanes.useWhen: You are building a product or admin surface with metrics, tables, and workflow context.

starterLanes.label: Forms and Operations
starterLanes.useWhen: You need inputs, authoring, uploads, and filtering for real application workflows.

starterLanes.label: Polish Layer
starterLanes.useWhen: The structure already works and you want motion, contrast, and visual depth without random ornament.
